source_selection: earliest interval with sufficient evidenced relevant-level native coverage, before Q16 outcome inspection
failures: retain all selected anchors and reasons; source/model contradictions invalidate the cohort; censored/solver-unknown outcomes remain missing; no replacement
uncertainty: missing-outcome identification bounds only for a defined cohort; contradictions suppress cohort bounds; no iid market-prevalence confidence interval for overlapping anchors
scope_limitation: observed cancellable residual is not original protected unit insertion; ten-event comparison uses only the secondary horizon explicitly frozen in this source-bound protocol
original_theoretical_controls: retain accepted source proofs and constructed stress probes separately; do not reinterpret quantity scaling as real observations
source_support_and_acceptance: source contract permits execution; independent reviewer and coordinator determine acceptance afterward
